what: Provenance of the Trade Craft Academy street artifact the parish worlds reuse (pack "parishes", maps/streets/<fips>.json): each file's source stamp and the lng/lat origin of its local-metre frame. Copied from the artifact once by `node tools/export_shared.mjs --refresh-streets` when the artifact is on this machine; the shared export reads only this file, so a clean checkout builds the same document as the machine that holds the artifact.
